preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 2 * 10**5 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) >= 2])
preconditions.description: Each test case has a number of vertices N between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N - 1 for N, edges in [(int(stdin.splitlines()[i]), [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[i+1:i+N]]) for i in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), N+1)])
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly N-1 edges, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for N, edges in [(int(stdin.splitlines()[i]), [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[i+1:i+N]]) for i in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), N+1)] for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects vertices u and v where 1 ≤ u, v ≤ N.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines) == T for T, output_lines in [(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]), [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()])])
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i].isdigit() for i, output_lines in enumerate([[line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()] for _ in range(T)]) if i < len(output_lines))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output_lines[i]) <= (N - 1) for i, (N, output_lines) in enumerate([(int(stdin.splitlines()[j]), [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]) for j in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), N+1)]) if i < len(output_lines))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a non-negative integer not exceeding N-1.

postconditions.expression: all(has_hamiltonian_path_with_edges_added(N, edges, int(output_lines[i])) for i, (N, edges, output_lines) in enumerate([(int(stdin.splitlines()[j]), [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[j+1:j+N]], [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]) for j in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), N+1)]) if i < len(output_lines))
postconditions.description: The output integer for each test case is the minimum number of edges to add to the tree to form a graph with a Hamiltonian path.
